abstract: OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the ultrasound features that can discriminate between benign and malignant ovarian cysts with papillary projections but no other solid component in pregnant women. METHODS: Thirty-four women with an ultrasound diagnosis of an ovarian cyst with papillary projections but no other solid component that had been removed surgically during pregnancy were identified from the databases of four ultrasound units. Some clinical and ultrasound information was collected prospectively. Missing information was obtained retrospectively from ultrasound images, ultrasound reports and patient records. Using prospectively and retrospectively collected data, the ultrasound appearance of the tumors was described using the terms and definitions of the International Ovarian Tumor Analysis group. The ultrasound characteristics were compared with the histological diagnosis. RESULTS: Of the 34 cases included, 19 (56%) lesions were benign (16 decidualized endometriomas, one cystadenofibroma, one simple cyst, one struma ovarii), 12 (35%) were borderline tumors and three (9%) were primary invasive tumors (two immature teratomas, one endometrioid cystadenocarcinoma). The contour of the cyst papillations was smooth in 79% (15/19) of benign tumors vs 27% (4/15) of malignant tumors (P = 0.002). The cystic content showed ground-glass echogenicity in 74% (14/19) of benign tumors vs 13% (2/15) of malignant tumors (P = 0.0006). All ovarian masses with smooth papillations and ground-glass content (n = 12) were decidualized endometriomas. The papillary projections were vascularized and the color score was 3 or 4 in 88% (14/16) of decidualized endometriomas vs 42% (5/12) of borderline tumors (P = 0.013). CONCLUSIONS: In pregnant women, ovarian cysts with ground-glass echogenicity and papillations with a smooth contour on ultrasound are most likely to be decidualized endometriomas. Cysts with anechoic or low-level echogenicity and papillations with an irregular contour suggest borderline malignancy. Copyright © 2016 ISUOG. Published by John Wiley & Sons Ltd.
abstract_ja: 目的:妊娠女性において、乳頭状突起を有するが他の充実性成分を持たない良性および悪性の卵巣嚢胞を鑑別しうる超音波所見を明らかにすること。方法:4施設の超音波検査室のデータベースから、妊娠中に外科的に摘出された、乳頭状突起を有するが他の充実性成分のない卵巣嚢胞の超音波診断を受けた女性34例を抽出した。一部の臨床および超音波情報は前向きに収集した。欠落情報は超音波画像、超音波報告書および患者記録から後方視的に取得した。前向きおよび後方視的に収集したデータを用いて、国際卵巣腫瘍解析グループの用語および定義を用いて腫瘍の超音波所見を記述した。超音波所見と組織学的診断を比較した。結果:含まれた34例のうち、19例(56%)が良性病変であった(16例は脱落膜化子宮内膜症、嚢胞腺線維腫1例、単純嚢胞1例、卵巣甲状腺腫1例)。12例(35%)は境界悪性腫瘍、3例(9%)は原発性浸潤性腫瘍であった(未熟奇形腫2例、類内膜嚢胞腺癌1例)。乳頭状突起の輪郭が滑らかな症例は良性腫瘍の79%(15/19)であったのに対し、悪性腫瘍では27%(4/15)であった(P = 0.002)。嚢胞内容がすりガラス様エコー輝度を示したのは、良性腫瘍の74%(14/19)であったのに対し、悪性腫瘍では13%(2/15)であった(P = 0.0006)。滑らかな乳頭状突起とすりガラス様内容物を有するすべての卵巣腫瘤(12例)は、脱落膜化子宮内膜症であった。乳頭状突起の血流は、脱落膜化子宮内膜症の88%(14/16)でカラースコア3または4であったのに対し、境界悪性腫瘍では42%(5/12)であった(P = 0.013)。結論:妊娠女性において、超音波でのすりガラス様エコー輝度と滑らかな輪郭の乳頭状突起を有する卵巣嚢胞は、脱落膜化子宮内膜症である可能性が最も高い。無エコーまたは低輝度エコーで不規則な輪郭の乳頭状突起を有する嚢胞は、境界悪性を示唆する。Copyright © 2016 ISUOG. Published by John Wiley & Sons Ltd.
